description: A set of unit tests for the DataElement and related classes within the WPEFramework Core module, testing data copying, comparison, search, setting, and linked data elements.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: A class representing a data storage container with copy and size management functionalities.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: A class encapsulating a data element with methods for copying, CRC calculation, search, and manipulation.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and iterating over DataElement instances.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A class representing linked data elements, allowing for chaining and composite data management.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into DataStore or DataElement from arrays or other objects.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the size of the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of the DataElement.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within the DataElement with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number value at a specified position within the DataElement.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number from the DataElement at a specified position.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within the DataElement.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets bits within the DataElement.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves bits from the DataElement.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value in the DataElement at a specified offset.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement data according to a specified type.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Encloses a linked DataElement within another.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Accesses buffer data within a range.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies linked data from another LinkedDataElement.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes in the parser.
